intro: The Federated States of Micronesia is four island states spread across the western Pacific, home to the ancient stone city of Nan Madol.

chapters.title: Nan Madol
text: On Pohnpei, the Saudeleur dynasty built Nan Madol from about 1100, a city of nearly 100 artificial islets made of stacked basalt columns.

highlight.title: Venice of the Pacific
highlight.text: Nan Madol is a World Heritage site.

chapters.title: Colonial rule
text: Spain claimed the Caroline Islands, then sold them to Germany in 1899. Japan ruled from 1914, and in World War Two Chuuk Lagoon was a Japanese naval base sunk by US attacks. The US then ran the islands for the UN.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Micronesia became self-governing in 1979 and independent in 1986 in free association with the US.
